dataList.data: Lists are ordered, mutable collections of items. They can contain items of different data types and are one of the most versatile data structures in Python.

# Empty list
empty_list = []

# List with items
fruits = ['apple', 'banana', 'cherry']

# Mixed data types
mixed = [1, 'hello', 3.14, True]

fruits = ['apple', 'banana', 'cherry']

# Access elements
print(fruits[0])  # apple
print(fruits[-1])  # cherry

# Add elements
fruits.append('orange')
fruits.insert(1, 'grape')

# Remove elements
fruits.remove('banana')
popped = fruits.pop()  # removes last element
